name: linux-arm64-kvm-counted-by-v1
purpose: Validate a low-noise semantic consumer of retained GCC counted_by metadata against focused tests and the complete pinned KVM irqchip.c translation unit.

environment.command_policy: The harness replaced only virt/kvm/irqchip.c in a one-entry compilation database derived from its exact successful ARM64 Kbuild command. The harness then included the complete source file.

supported_accesses: reads and writes through annotated flexible-array fields
reads and writes through direct GCC 16 counted pointer fields
proof_conditions: the index is negative in every represented Eva state
the signed associated count is nonpositive in every represented Eva state
the minimum index is at least the maximum associated count
the uncast index expression is structurally the associated counter lvalue
silence_policy: address formation without a memory access
functions unreachable from the selected Eva entry point

focused_validation.cast_safety_control: A value-changing unsigned-char cast of a count equal to 260 yields index 4 and is not treated as structural entries[count] equality.

exact_kvm_controls.name: real-source signed-GSI control
exact_kvm_controls.scenario: Set nr_rt_entries to 1 and call the real kvm_irq_map_gsi() with UINT_MAX converted through its signed int gsi parameter.
exact_kvm_controls.interpretation: The comparison with u32 nr_rt_entries converts gsi back to u32. UINT_MAX fails the guard and cannot reach map[-1].

exact_kvm_controls.name: synthetic sensitivity control
exact_kvm_controls.scenario: Bypass the real guard in harness-only code and read map[-1] while nr_rt_entries is 1.
exact_kvm_controls.interpretation: The checker recognizes the retained map/nr_rt_entries association in the complete translation unit. This access is not Linux source.

candidate_disposition.reason: The suspected negative signed GSI cannot pass the actual unsigned source guard.

validation.optional_lint_wrappers: not available in the opam switch: ocp-indent.dynlink and headache are missing

limitations: The checker requires Eva reachability and currently follows direct field expressions rather than copied pointers or general aliases.
It proves violations relative to the associated count; it does not prove that the backing allocation is at least that large.
It intentionally leaves overlapping or mixed intervals inconclusive and does not model concurrent counter changes.
The KVM result is one bounded IRQ-routing scenario, not whole-function, whole-file, or whole-subsystem verification.
interpretation: This milestone converts counted_by frontend compatibility into a tested bug-finding primitive and demonstrates sensitivity in a complete ARM64 Kbuild context. It found no violation in the tested Linux path and therefore makes no new Linux kernel bug claim.
